name: Vanilla
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: small ice cream flavor order icon for Unity. Edit only the supplied Vanilla scoop image. Remove every brown vanilla fleck, dot, speck, and embedded chunk. This vanilla must be completely plain ivory ice cream. Preserve the existing base color, overall ball silhouette, centered composition, low-poly style, size, diffuse lighting, and perfectly plain white background. No cone, text, labels, border, shadow outside the scoop, extra objects, or checkerboard. The plain flavors must contain zero contrasting bits; surface faceting in the same ice cream color is fine. Make the result immediately readable at 80 pixels.
